name: Air Quality Agent
description: Read-only agent over Open-Meteo's keyless air-quality model: current US AQI with its EPA band and what it means, PM2.5, PM10, ozone, nitrogen and sulphur dioxide, carbon monoxide, UV and pollen at any point or known city; an hourly AQI outlook up to 72 hours; one-request comparisons across cities; and a watch that POSTs to your webhook when the AQI band changes or a threshold is crossed. Every answer says which model grid it came from. This hosted endpoint answers air-now, air-forecast; the local server additionally implements air-ranking, air-watch.

skills.name: Air quality right now
skills.description: Current air quality at a latitude/longitude point or a known place: US AQI with its EPA band and what that band means, PM2.5, PM10, ozone, nitrogen and sulphur dioxide, carbon monoxide, UV index, and pollen where the model publishes it.
examples: How bad is the air in Delhi right now?

skills.name: Air quality forecast
skills.description: Hourly US AQI and PM2.5 from the current hour forward for up to 72 hours, with the peak hour in the window and the cleanest hour. Model output, read live.
examples: What will the air quality be like in Denver for the next 48 hours?

name: Aurora Space Weather Agent
description: Read-only agent over NOAA's Space Weather Prediction Center: current geomagnetic conditions and the 24-hour peak, NOAA's predicted planetary Kp for the next days, the OVATION model's aurora probability at a place or latitude/longitude point, recent SWPC watches and warnings parsed into fields, and a watch skill that POSTs to your webhook when geomagnetic activity shifts. Every number is read live from swpc.noaa.gov, and the answers say which product it came from. This hosted endpoint answers aurora-now, aurora-forecast, aurora-visibility; the local server additionally implements aurora-messages, aurora-watch.

skills.name: Current space weather
skills.description: Geomagnetic conditions right now: NOAA's estimated planetary Kp, the plain-language activity band, the peak of the last 24 hours, and the newest SWPC message headline.
examples: How are the geomagnetic conditions right now?

skills.name: Kp forecast
skills.description: NOAA's 3-hourly predicted planetary Kp for the next days, grouped by UTC day with the days own peak, the storm grade that peak would reach, and any storm watch in force.
examples: What is the aurora forecast for the next 3 days?

skills.name: Aurora probability at a place
skills.description: NOAA's OVATION model gives the probability of aurora overhead at a latitude/longitude, or at a named city from this server's built-in list. Reports the model run time and the best probability within a couple of degrees of the point.
examples: What are the odds of seeing the aurora in Fairbanks tonight?

name: NWS Weather Alerts Agent
description: Read-only agent over the National Weather Service alerts feed (api.weather.gov): active watches, warnings and advisories by state, NWS zone or latitude/longitude point, live national and per-state counts, and a watch skill that POSTs to your webhook when a new alert is issued for a place. Every answer is read live from the NWS API, and says so. This hosted endpoint answers alerts-active, alerts-summary; the local server additionally implements alerts-watch.

skills.name: Active weather alerts
skills.description: Active National Weather Service watches, warnings and advisories for a state, an NWS zone, or a latitude/longitude point, most severe first. Includes headline, timing, area description and the safety instruction.
examples: Any weather alerts in NY right now?

skills.name: Active alert counts
skills.description: Live National Weather Service counts: how many alerts are active across the country (split into land and marine) and how many are active in a given state.
examples: How many weather alerts are active nationwide?

name: USGS Earthquake Agent
description: Read-only agent over the live USGS earthquake catalog: recent earthquakes worldwide by magnitude and time window, quakes inside a radius of a point or known metro area, live catalog counts, and a watch skill that POSTs to your webhook when a new qualifying earthquake is recorded. Every answer is read live from the USGS FDSN event service. This hosted endpoint answers quakes-recent, quakes-near, quakes-summary; the local server additionally implements quakes-watch.

skills.name: Recent earthquakes
skills.description: Earthquakes recorded by the USGS in a time window, worldwide, filtered by minimum magnitude and sorted newest first. Each event carries magnitude, place, depth, tsunami flag, felt reports and the USGS event page URL.
examples: Any earthquakes above magnitude 4.5 in the last 24 hours?

skills.name: Earthquakes near a place
skills.description: Earthquakes within a radius of a latitude/longitude point, or of a known metro area such as Tokyo, Lima, Istanbul or San Francisco. Answers 'has anything shaken near me'.
examples: any quakes near Tokyo this month?

skills.name: Live earthquake counts
skills.description: How much the ground has moved lately: how many quakes the USGS catalogued worldwide in the last 24 hours at magnitude 2.5+ and 4.5+, and in the last 7 days at 6.0+, plus the largest recent event.

name: openFDA Recalls Agent
description: Read-only agent over openFDA enforcement reports: recent drug, food and medical device recalls, keyword/firm/state/class search, counts by classification, lookup by recall number, and a watch skill that POSTs when a new recall matches your filters. Every answer is read live from openFDA and carries openFDA's own unvalidated-data disclaimer. This hosted endpoint answers recalls-recent, recall-search, recall-lookup; the local server additionally implements recalls-summary, recalls-watch.

skills.name: Recent recalls
skills.description: The newest recall records from openFDA enforcement reports, across drugs, food and medical devices, newest report date first. Filter by scope, classification, state or date window.
examples: what was recalled in the last 7 days?
any Class I food recalls this month?

skills.name: Search recalls
skills.description: Search the recall registers for a product, a firm, a reason or a state — for example romaine, a company name, or 'undeclared milk'. Counts and dates are openFDA's.
examples: any recalls by firm Crown Farms?
recalls mentioning undeclared milk in CA

skills.name: Look up a recall
skills.description: One recall record by its recall number, for example H-1331-2026 or D-0835-2026. Returns the firm, product, reason, classification, status and distribution.

name: NOAA Tides Agent
description: Read-only agent over NOAA CO-OPS tide data: high/low tide predictions, the next high and low, the latest observed water level placed against published flood stages, tide-station lookup by name/state/point, and a watch skill that POSTs to your webhook when the water crosses a height or flood stage. Every answer is read live from NOAA and names the datum. This hosted endpoint answers tide-next, tide-predictions, stations; the local server additionally implements water-level, tide-watch.

skills.name: Next high and low tide
skills.description: The next high tide and the next low tide for a NOAA tide station, with heights.
examples: when is the next high tide at 8518750?

skills.name: Tide predictions
skills.description: Upcoming high and low tides for a NOAA tide station, in station local time, from the current observation forward. Give a seven-digit station id, 'lat,lon' for the nearest station, or a station name.
examples: what are the tides at station 8518750 today?
tide table for the next 3 days near 40.7006,-74.0142

skills.name: Find tide stations
skills.description: Search the NOAA tide-station catalogue by name, by two-letter state code, or by distance from a latitude/longitude point. 3499 tide-prediction stations worldwide (US coasts and territories).
